subject: src/main/java/kr/co/oruda/onsure/platform/SemanticAssuranceV2DispatcherBridge.java (requireSemanticRole), src/main/java/kr/co/oruda/onsure/platform/TenantRbacService.java
observed_source: SemanticAssuranceV2DispatcherBridgeTest (real dispatch through the full RBAC chain)
coverage_notes: requireSemanticRole's role-tier mechanism (VIEWER/OPERATOR/APPROVER/AUDITOR/ADMIN, per-operation gate switch) already existed and was exercised implicitly by hundreds of tests that all use an ADMIN-tier caller -- but its DENIAL path had zero direct test coverage before this evidence, since ADMIN passes every gate. Added negative tests proving genuine separation: a VIEWER-only actor is denied even the lowest operator-tier operation; an OPERATOR-only actor is denied an auditor-tier operation (hazard.advance) while an AUDITOR-only actor reaches the equivalent auditor-tier operation (hazard.create) that same OPERATOR could not; and the one deliberate asymmetry in the whole role table -- assurance.otester.accept/oaudit.accept check auditor alone, without '|| admin' -- is verified directly: even an ADMIN-only actor (no AUDITOR role) is denied, meaning an administrator cannot self-certify as the independent tester/auditor acceptor.
